notes.title: "Hidden" price will be changed to "free-to-play"
notes.content:
As mentioned in title, the game "Hidden" will have its game price changed to "free-to-play". This change is scheduled to take effect from 25 Sept 2021 at 0:00 GMT +8. Thank you.


Additional note:
Hi, this is Fan, former member of the team.
It's been a long time. Hope anyone who reading this are doing well.
If you have been following since the game was released, you may have noticed that the game has no update whatsoever for over 1year. Some of you may have known the reason for this: the team is disbanded. I have read through the game reviews and the forum. And what I want to say is: thank you for playing this game. Sorry that we had let your expectation down. 
We are now busy with our life. In fact, I even had trouble contacting the team members to ask for permission to set this game to a free-to-play game. Sad. But I did got permission from our leader, so here you go... Though I personally do think we should have made this change earlier, like, since the release.
I can't think of anything else I can do for those who had already bought the game, so I drew the image used in this news as a thanks for all of you. (Lost contact with the member with latest game file, and I don't have the file with me. Also I have my life as well. So, sorry...)
That's all from me. Thank you, and have a good day. May we meet again someday, somewhere...(Pls dont hit me if we do meet again *sweat)

TL;DR: Thank you for playing the game, and sorry for not meeting your expectation. Glad that I got permission to change this game to free-to-play. Also as thanks, I drew the news' image, hope you liked it.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1sIbtY7.png[/img]

notes.title: v1.0.6 Update Notes
notes.content:
1. Main menu: Added simple level selection when starting new game.
2. Collectibles are not reset on new game anymore.
3. The door that require holding switch in the first laser room area now permanently opens after solving the laser puzzle.
4. Slight changes in several dialogues.
5. Slight changes in the laser reflector mechanics.

notes.title: v1.0.5 Update Notes
notes.content:
1. Added new options in pause menu:
    1.1 Restart from last checkpoint - Load auto-saved file.
    1.2 Quick save - Manually save the game.
    1.3 Quick load - Load quick-saved file.

2. Changed some tables' collider. Player can now crawl beneath these tables.

3. Several bug-fixes: 
- Character no longer stuck while holding the corner of the movable laser terminals.
- Character no longer stuck on chairs.
- Movable objects can no longer be pushed/pulled diagonally from the corner.
